paragraphs.en: Voicebox is built and maintained with Capy . A Capy Captain thread directs the project day to day, and its crew threads test, rebase, and review each contributor pull request on Linux and on a Mac Studio before Jamie merges it. Voicebox stays free and open source under the MIT license, with no splash screens, banners, or interruptions in the app.
paragraphs.zh: Voicebox 使用 Capy 构建和维护。 一个 Capy Captain 线程负责项目的日常管理，其船员线程在 Linux 和一台 Mac Studio 上测试、变基并审查每位贡献者的拉取请求，然后由 Jamie 合并。 Voicebox 在 MIT 许可证下保持免费开源，应用内没有任何启动画面、横幅或干扰。

paragraphs.en: Voicebox is a local-first AI voice studio — a free and open-source alternative to ElevenLabs and WisprFlow in one app. Clone voices from a few seconds of audio, generate speech in 23 languages across 8 TTS engines, dictate into any text field with a global hotkey, and give any MCP-aware AI agent a voice of your choosing.
paragraphs.zh: Voicebox 是一款本地优先的 AI 语音工作室——在一个应用中同时提供 ElevenLabs 和 WisprFlow 的免费开源替代方案。 用几秒钟的音频克隆声音，通过 8 个 TTS 引擎生成 23 种语言的语音，用全局快捷键在任何文本框中听写，并让任何支持 MCP 的智能体使用你选择的声音。

sents.en: Voicebox is a local-first AI voice studio — a free and open-source alternative to ElevenLabs and WisprFlow in one app.
sents.zh: Voicebox 是一款本地优先的 AI 语音工作室——在一个应用中同时提供 ElevenLabs 和 WisprFlow 的免费开源替代方案。

sents.en: Clone voices from a few seconds of audio, generate speech in 23 languages across 8 TTS engines, dictate into any text field with a global hotkey, and give any MCP-aware AI agent a voice of your choosing.
sents.zh: 用几秒钟的音频克隆声音，通过 8 个 TTS 引擎生成 23 种语言的语音，用全局快捷键在任何文本框中听写，并让任何支持 MCP 的智能体使用你选择的声音。

paragraphs.en: The two cloud incumbents sit on opposite halves of the voice I/O loop — ElevenLabs on output, WisprFlow on input. Voicebox does both, bridges them with a bundled local LLM for refinement and per-profile personas, and runs the whole thing on your machine.
paragraphs.zh: 两大云计算领域的老牌厂商分别位于语音输入输出回路的两个半边——ElevenLabs 负责输出，WisprFlow 负责输入。 Voicebox 两者兼备，通过内置的本地 LLM 进行润色并支持按配置档案设定不同人格，从而将两者衔接起来，而且整个过程都在你的机器上运行。

paragraphs.en: Eight TTS engines with different strengths, switchable per-generation:
paragraphs.zh: 八个各有所长的 TTS 引擎，可在每次生成时切换：

paragraphs.en: Only Chatterbox Turbo interprets paralinguistic tags like [laugh] and [sigh] . Qwen3-TTS, LuxTTS, Chatterbox Multilingual, and HumeAI TADA read them literally as text.
paragraphs.zh: 只有 Chatterbox Turbo 能解读 [laugh] 和 [sigh] 这类副语言标签。 Qwen3-TTS、LuxTTS、Chatterbox Multilingual 和 HumeAI TADA 会把它们当作文本按字面读取。

paragraphs.en: With Chatterbox Turbo selected, type / in the text input to open the tag inserter and add expressive tags inline with speech:
paragraphs.zh: 在选中 Chatterbox Turbo 的情况下，在文本输入框中输入 / 以打开标签插入器，并在语音中内联添加表现力标签：

paragraphs.en: Sounds: [laugh] [chuckle] [gasp] [cough] [sigh] [groan] [sniff] [shush] [clear throat]
paragraphs.zh: 声音：[笑] [轻笑] [倒吸气] [咳嗽] [叹气] [呻吟] [抽鼻子] [嘘声] [清嗓子]

paragraphs.en: Text is automatically split at sentence boundaries and each chunk is generated independently, then crossfaded together. Works with all engines.
paragraphs.zh: 文本会在句子边界处自动分割，每个片段独立生成，然后交叉淡入合并在一起。适用于所有引擎。

paragraphs.en: Voicebox runs OpenAI Whisper for transcription — the same model that backs dictation, the Captures tab, and the /transcribe API. Running on MLX (Apple Silicon) or PyTorch (CUDA / ROCm / DirectML / CPU) depending on your platform.
paragraphs.zh: Voicebox 使用 OpenAI Whisper 进行转录——该模型与驱动听写、Captures 标签页以及 /transcribe API 的模型相同。 根据你的平台运行在 MLX（Apple Silicon）或 PyTorch（CUDA / ROCm / DirectML / CPU）之上。

paragraphs.en: More engines (Parakeet v3, Qwen3-ASR) are planned — see Roadmap .

paragraphs.en: Every dictation, in-app recording, and uploaded audio file lands in the Captures tab — original audio paired with transcript, always preserved.
paragraphs.zh: 每一次听写、应用内录音和上传的音频文件都会进入「Captures」（捕获）标签页——原始音频与转录文本配对保存，始终保留。

paragraphs.en: Every agent gets a voice. One tool call and any MCP-aware agent can speak to you in a voice you've cloned — task completions, questions, notifications. The same pill that surfaces during dictation surfaces during agent speech, so you always see what's coming out of your machine.
paragraphs.zh: 每个智能体都能发声。 只需一次工具调用，任何支持 MCP 的智能体都能用你克隆的嗓音对你说话——任务完成提示、提问、通知。 在智能体说话时出现的提示胶囊与听写时出现的相同，因此你总能看到机器正在输出的内容。

paragraphs.en: // In any MCP-aware agent: await voicebox_speak ( { text : "Deploy complete." , profile : "Morgan" , } ) ; Also exposed as POST /speak for anything that doesn't speak MCP — ACP, A2A, shell scripts, custom harnesses.
paragraphs.zh: // 在任何支持 MCP 的智能体中：await voicebox_speak ( { text : "部署完成。" , profile : "Morgan" , } ) ; 同时以 POST /speak 的形式暴露，供不支持 MCP 的对象使用——ACP、A2A、shell 脚本、自定义测试框架。

paragraphs.en: Attach a free-form personality to any voice profile — who this voice is, how they speak, what they care about. Two actions appear on the generate box when a personality is set, powered by a bundled Qwen3 LLM running entirely locally.
paragraphs.zh: 为任意语音配置附加一个自由格式的个性描述 —— 这个声音是谁、如何说话、关心什么。 设置个性后，生成框上会出现两个操作，由一个完全本地运行的内置 Qwen3 大语言模型驱动。

sents.en: Attach a free-form personality to any voice profile — who this voice is, how they speak, what they care about.
sents.zh: 为任意语音配置附加一个自由格式的个性描述 —— 这个声音是谁、如何说话、关心什么。

sents.en: Two actions appear on the generate box when a personality is set, powered by a bundled Qwen3 LLM running entirely locally.
sents.zh: 设置个性后，生成框上会出现两个操作，由一个完全本地运行的内置 Qwen3 大语言模型驱动。

paragraphs.en: Agents can reach the same rewrite path over MCP by passing personality: true to voicebox_speak , turning the tool into a text-in → personality-LLM → TTS pipeline. The same LLM backs dictation's refinement step — one LLM in the app, one model cache, one GPU-memory footprint.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体可以通过向 voicebox_speak 传入 personality: true，经由 MCP 走到相同的改写路径，从而把该工具变成「文本输入 → 个性 LLM → TTS」的流水线。 同一个 LLM 也支撑听写功能的润色步骤——应用中只有一个 LLM、一份模型缓存、一块显存占用。

sents.en: Agents can reach the same rewrite path over MCP by passing personality: true to voicebox_speak , turning the tool into a text-in → personality-LLM → TTS pipeline.
sents.zh: 智能体可以通过向 voicebox_speak 传入 personality: true，经由 MCP 走到相同的改写路径，从而把该工具变成「文本输入 → 个性 LLM → TTS」的流水线。

paragraphs.en: Local LLM options: Qwen3 0.6B / 1.7B / 4B, sharing the TTS runtime (MLX on Apple Silicon, PyTorch elsewhere).
paragraphs.zh: 本地大语言模型选项：Qwen3 0.6B / 1.7B / 4B，共享 TTS 运行时（Apple Silicon 上使用 MLX，其他平台使用 PyTorch）。

paragraphs.en: Use cases: agent dev loops (dictate a question, hear the answer in a cloned voice), interactive characters for games and narrative tools, speech assistance for people who can't speak in their original voice.
paragraphs.zh: 用例：智能体开发循环（口述一个问题，用克隆的声音听到答案）、游戏与叙事工具中的交互式角色、为无法用原声说话的人提供语音辅助。

paragraphs.en: Voicebox exposes a REST API for integrating voice I/O into your own apps and agents.
paragraphs.zh: Voicebox 提供了一个 REST API，用于将语音输入/输出集成到你自己的应用和智能体中。

paragraphs.en: # Generate speech curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:17493/generate \ -H " Content-Type: application/json " \ -d ' {"text": "Hello world", "profile_id": "abc123", "language": "en"} ' # Agent voice output — any app or script can speak in a cloned voice curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:17493/speak \ -H " Content-Type: application/json " \ -H " X-Voicebox-Client-Id: my-script " \ -d ' {"text": "Deploy complete.", "profile": "Morgan"} ' # Transcribe an audio file curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:17493/transcribe \ -F " audio=@recording.wav " \ -F " model=whisper-turbo " # List voice profiles curl http://127.0.0.1:17493/profiles POST /speak accepts profile as a name (case-insensitive) or id, and resolves via the same precedence as the MCP tool: explicit arg → per-client binding → capture_settings.default_playback_voice_id .
paragraphs.zh: # 生成语音 curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:17493/generate \ -H " Content-Type: application/json " \ -d ' {"text": "Hello world", "profile_id": "abc123", "language": "en"} ' # 智能体语音输出——任何应用或脚本都可以用克隆的声音说话 curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:17493/speak \ -H " Content-Type: application/json " \ -H " X-Voicebox-Client-Id: my-script " \ -d ' {"text": "Deploy complete.", "profile": "Morgan"} ' # 转录音频文件 curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:17493/transcribe \ -F " audio=@recording.wav " \ -F " model=whisper-turbo " # 列出语音配置 curl http://127.0.0.1:17493/profiles POST /speak 接受 profile 作为名称（不区分大小写）或 id，并按照与 MCP 工具相同的优先级进行解析：显式参数 → 每客户端绑定 → capture_settings.default_playback_voice_id 。

paragraphs.en: Voicebox ships a built-in Model Context Protocol server so any MCP-aware agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, VS Code MCP extensions) can speak, transcribe, and browse captures and profiles.
paragraphs.zh: Voicebox 内置了一个 Model Context Protocol（模型上下文协议）服务器，因此任何支持 MCP 的智能体（Claude Code、Cursor、Windsurf、Cline、VS Code MCP 扩展）都可以进行语音合成、转录，并浏览捕获内容与配置档案。

paragraphs.en: claude mcp add voicebox \ --transport http \ --url http://127.0.0.1:17493/mcp \ --header "X-Voicebox-Client-Id: claude-code" Any HTTP MCP client (Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, etc.):
paragraphs.zh:
```bash
claude mcp add voicebox \
  --transport http \
  --url http://127.0.0.1:17493/mcp \
  --header "X-Voicebox-Client-Id: claude-code"
```

任何 HTTP MCP 客户端（Cursor、Windsurf、VS Code 等）：

paragraphs.en: { "mcpServers" : { "voicebox" : { "url" : " http://127.0.0.1:17493/mcp " , "headers" : { "X-Voicebox-Client-Id" : " cursor " } } } } Stdio fallback for clients that don't speak HTTP MCP — point at the bundled voicebox-mcp binary inside the app:
paragraphs.zh: { "mcpServers" : { "voicebox" : { "url" : " http://127.0.0.1:17493/mcp " , "headers" : { "X-Voicebox-Client-Id" : " cursor " } } } } 为不支持 HTTP MCP 的客户端提供 Stdio 回退方案 —— 将其指向应用内置的 voicebox-mcp 二进制文件即可：

paragraphs.en: { "mcpServers" : { "voicebox" : { "command" : " /Applications/Voicebox.app/Contents/MacOS/voicebox-mcp " , "env" : { "VOICEBOX_CLIENT_ID" : " claude-desktop " } } } } Four tools ship: voicebox_speak , voicebox_transcribe , voicebox_list_captures , voicebox_list_profiles . Per-client voice bindings are managed in Voicebox → Settings → MCP . See the full MCP guide for tool signatures, resolution precedence, the speaking-pill contract, and security notes.

paragraphs.en: Prerequisites: Bun , Rust , Python 3.12 , Tauri Prerequisites , and Xcode on macOS.

paragraphs.en: The repo ships a pre-wired .mcp.json at the root — running Claude Code inside this checkout picks up the Voicebox MCP tools automatically once the dev app is running.
paragraphs.zh: 仓库在根目录附带了一个预配置好的 .mcp.json —— 一旦开发应用运行起来，在此代码签出目录内运行 Claude Code 即可自动加载 Voicebox MCP 工具。

paragraphs.en: just build # Build CPU server binary + Tauri app just build-local # (Windows) Build CPU + CUDA server binaries + Tauri app Adding New Voice Models The multi-engine architecture makes adding new TTS engines straightforward. A step-by-step guide covers the full process: dependency research, backend protocol implementation, frontend wiring, and PyInstaller bundling.
paragraphs.zh: 仅需运行 `# 构建 CPU 服务端二进制文件 + Tauri 应用` 的 `just build`，或 `# （Windows）构建 CPU + CUDA 服务端二进制文件 + Tauri 应用` 的 `just build-local`。添加新语音模型：多引擎架构使添加新的 TTS 引擎变得简单直接。 有一份分步指南涵盖了完整流程：依赖项调研、后端协议实现、前端接入，以及 PyInstaller 打包。

paragraphs.en: The guide is optimized for AI coding agents. An agent skill can pick up a model name and handle the entire integration autonomously — you just test the build locally.
